lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Joel son of Pethuel, who asked if anything like this had happened before.
Four kinds of locust came, and an invading nation with a lion's teeth laid waste the olive tree.
Grain and drink offerings were cut off from the house of the LORD, and the priests were in mourning.
Joel told the priests to spend the night in sackcloth and said the Day of the LORD comes as darkness.
The herds wandered because they had no pasture, and fire consumed the open pastures and scorched the trees.
